title: gluta macrocarpa
intro: Gluta macrocarpa, commonly known as the Tengkawang tree, is a species of plant in the family Anacardiaceae. The health benefits of Gluta macrocarpa include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, which may help to prevent chronic diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Gluta macrocarpa include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gluta macrocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may also contribute to its potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects.
